title: The Habit That Once Helped
short_teaser: A habit may have protected us during one season and become limiting in another.
story: A habit may have protected us during one season and become limiting in another. Compassion and change can exist together. Reflection turns experience into guidance rather than leaving it as an unexamined memory. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Compassion and change can exist together. Reflection turns experience into guidance rather than leaving it as an unexamined memory.
spark_application: Write one lesson worth keeping and one thing you may do differently. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
